title: Document renderer command-line result, contract version 1
description: The JSON object 'python -m hms_docrender render' writes to standard output (docs/specs/modules/platform-docs.md §7.5). Exit codes: 0 rendered, 1 failed (render or runtime error), 2 usage error, 3 invalid request, 4 refused (a refused resource, a font integrity failure, text the fonts cannot render, or a network attempt). The PDF is written to --out only when the status is rendered; otherwise no file is left there.

sha256.description: rendered: SHA-256 of the PDF, lower-case hex.

rendererIdentity.description: rendered: the renderer identity (spec §10): library versions and the print fonts' SHA-256s.

identityHash.description: rendered: the first 16 hex digits of the identity's SHA-256; names the golden image set.

code.description: failed or refused: a stable reason code.

detail.description: failed or refused: what went wrong; never the document's text.

errors.description: invalid: one message per contract violation.
